title: Ohne-Schnickschnack-Server
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack designed to improve Minecraft server performance while adding a few quality-of-life features.
body:
# Ohne Schnickschnack Modpack (Server Version)

A lightweight Fabric modpack focused on **server performance and stability**.  
It includes powerful optimization mods like **ServerCore**, **FerriteCore**, **Lithium**, and more to help your server run smoother and handle more players.

## Recommended Setup

This pack can technically run on both client and server, but it is **intended for server-side use**.

For the best experience, combine it with the client version:  
[Ohne Schnickschnack Modpack (Client Version)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ohne-schnickschnack), which adds additional gameplay improvements.

## Fun Add-ons

The following mods within this modpack do not primarily focus on performance but instead add **quality-of-life improvements and fun features**:

- **AppleSkin** → Displays an accurate representation of your hunger and saturation.
- **Do a Barrel Roll** → Lets you literally do a barrel roll while flying with an Elytra :)
- **No Portals** → Allows you to dynamically control whether certain dimensions are accessible.
- **Shulker Box Tooltip** → Lets you preview the contents of your Shulker Boxes and Ender Chests.
- **Simple Voice Chat** → Enables in-game voice chat with friends, including optional proximity chat.
- **Xaero's Minimap / World Map** → Adds a minimap and a full-screen world map with extensive configuration options.
